svg.title: Wayfinder: bounded generative travel UI
svg.desc: A source-backed system diagram. A traveler request moves from the browser chat shell to a strict local Codex agent, through scene validation into a TravelSurface of registered React components. Browser-owned state, the PlanningTracker and bounded projection coordinator remain outside model control; a closed Python API queries the server-side 50-million-row SQLite fare fixture.
